name: product-marketing-context
description:
Use this skill whenever starting any marketing, content, or campaign work for a venture.
MUST run before email sequences, social content, lead magnets, ad creatives, or copy editing.
Run 4 times — once per venture (SIPP, WIC, CC, Bennovative) — to seed .agents/ context files
that all downstream marketing skills read automatically.
Triggers: "set up marketing context", "venture context", "product context", "brand context file",
"start marketing for", "create positioning doc".
